title: अक्षरगन्ज उपन्यासमा अङ्ग्रेजी भाषिक कोड मिश्रणको अध्ययन{Akṣaraganja upanyasma angreji bhasika kod misranako adhyyan}
authors: नायक Nayak, गोपिन्द सिंह Gopinda Singh
nepali: शोध शीर्षक ः अक्षरगन्ज उपन्यासमा अङ्ग्रेजी भाषिक कोड मिश्रणको अध्ययन शोधार्थी ः गोपिन्द सिंह नायक शोध निर्देशक ः सहप्रा. रविकिरण अधिकारी विभाग ः शिक्षाशास्त्र सङ्काय, नेपाली भाषा शिक्षा विभाग, त्रि.वि. कीर्तिपुर शैक्षिक कार्य ः २०७२÷०७३ पृष्ठ सङ्ख्या ः  ८८ + २२ जम्मा अध्याय ः सात शोधकार्यको उद्देश्य प्रस्तुत अध्ययनका उद्देश्यहरू निम्नानुसार रहेका छन् ः क)	‘अक्षरगन्ज’ उपन्यासमा प्रत्युक्त अङ्ग्रेजी भाषाका कोडहरू पत्ता लगाउनु, ख)	‘अक्षरगन्ज’ उपन्यासमा प्रयुक्त अङ्ग्रेजी कोडहरू भाषिक तहका आधारमा विश्लेषण गर्नु, ग)	उक्त उपन्यासमा अङ्ग्रेजी कोड मिश्रणको कारण र प्रभावकारिता पत्ता लगाउनु ।
american_english:
Research title: A Study of English Linguistic Code Mixing in the Novel Aksharganj
Researcher: Gopinda Singh Nayak
Research adviser: Associate Prof. Ravikiran Adhikari
Department: Faculty of Education, Department of Nepali Language Education, Tribhuvan University, Kirtipur
Academic work: 2072/073
Number of pages: 88 + 22
Total chapters: seven
Objectives of the research work: The objectives of the present study are as follows:
(a) to find out the English language codes used in the novel 'Aksharganj',
(b) to analyze the English codes used in the novel 'Aksharganj' on the basis of the linguistic level,
(c) to find out the reason and effectiveness of English code mixing in that novel.

informal_english: So this one's called 'A Study of English Linguistic Code Mixing in the Novel Aksharganj,' by Gopinda Singh Nayak, under Associate Prof. Ravikiran Adhikari in the Department of Nepali Language Education, Faculty of Education, Tribhuvan University, Kirtipur, for 2072/073. It's seven chapters, 88 plus 22 pages. The aims are simple: (a) find out what English codes are used in 'Aksharganj', (b) analyse those English codes by linguistic level, and (c) work out why the English code mixing is there and how well it works.
